sn16.12:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca mahākassapo āyasmā ca sāriputto bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
sn16.12:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ patillānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākassapo tenupasaṅkami …pe…
sn16.12:1.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ etadavoca:
sn16.12:1.4: kinnu kho āvuso, kassapa hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn16.12:1.7: kiṃ panāvuso, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti? etampi
sn16.12:1.10: kinnu kho āvuso, hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn16.12:1.12: “hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn16.12:1.13: kiṃ panāvuso, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti? etampi
sn16.12:1.15: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn16.12:1.17: na hetaṃ āvuso atthasaṃhitaṃ ādibrahmacariyakaṃ, na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
sn16.12:2.2: idaṃ dukkhanti kho āvuso, byākataṃ bhagavatā.
sn16.12:2.7: etaṃ hi āvuso, atthasaṃhitaṃ, etaṃ ādibrahmacariyakaṃ, etaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
